title: Fixes compatibility issue with Canon R5 C (read edit though)
text:
Went to import some raw photos off my Canon R5 C. In theory they are exactly the same as the raw files off the R5, but there are two extra bytes of data in the EXIF (in the camera string) that make the raw files incompatible with all editors (Lightroom, Apple's own photos app, etc.). Changing the camera from "Canon EOS R5 C" to "Canon EOS R5" makes the raw files work in everything. Ads are a bit obnoxious, but that's what I get for not buying the pro version. It works exactly as intended for my very specific use case and that's really what matters.

Edit to add: noticed that it started saving JPEGs from my raw photos, had to stop using.

Second, if you used the “remove all metadata” option on a photo, it does not do that and keeps the time and date. But that’s part of the metadata! It should also be removed. Basically, the app needs to correct these flaws before anyone should consider getting it, so don’t get it until, or if ever, then.
